title: "Disable Automatic Self-Proposal in Planning Mode"
body:
**Bug Description**
i really don't like the new change where it self-proposes what to do when i start in planning mode\
\
i want to be in plan mode! i want to ask it follow up questions. i want to decide myself when to start coding\
\
please revert this, or make it turn-off-able in the settings

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.21
- Feedback ID: 5f8f777f-13c9-4523-91eb-9e4d580f527a
